summary: Sky desktop revision frozen and handed to independent Docker QA: own final6/6 native+gated finish checks, separate actual held-input Escape proofs and cursor observations PASS. Baseline metrics below remain historical.

keyboard.detail: Both viewer paths and normalized API preserve exact tested mixed-case ASCII/punctuation/LF string. Normalized text rejects unsupported Unicode422; native physical keys use explicit modifiers.

click.detail: Both viewer routes and normalized automation, synthetic fixture.

rightClick.detail: Both viewer routes and normalized input, real contextmenu event.

doubleClick.detail: Both viewer routes, real dblclick event.

drag.detail: Both routes from fresh fixture; pointer down/moves/up and real drop.

scroll.detail: Both wheel axes independently tested on native and gated viewer paths. Wheel is emulated X11 scrolling; no native trackpad gesture proof.

modifiers.detail: Control/Shift tested, held release on revoke, blur, disconnect, expiry and invalid batch.

screenshot.detail: Real Neko X11 JPEG, 640x360 and1280x720, bounded resize/source mapping; image personally inspected.

humanTakeover.detail: Both modes block stale/new bot sends, cancel queued producer and release held state. Native xterm exact command-output proof and stable controller-send count independently passed; already-delivered application events can settle after acknowledgment.

pinchNative.detail: Custom Xorg native touch driver disabled in this configuration; physical Mac gesture untested.

swipeNative.detail: No native touch driver; wheel/drag are emulated.

zoomEmulated.detail: Ctrl+wheel through Neko; explicit emulation, independent QA pending.

audio.detail: Received synthetic250ms440Hz tone as decoded PCM; peak RMS0.04253. Silent baseline, zero-gain output; no microphone or physical listening.

theme.detail: Actual wallpaper, tint2 panel, launcher icons and toolbar-launched xterm; native generic command-output takeover independently passed. Clean restart/fresh fixture capture passed separately from preserved appearance-helper restoration failure.

lifecycle.overall: Prior aggregate FAIL on terminal title assertion preserved; independent final clean restart and native terminal takeover passed separately.

exactText.aggregate: Earlier aggregate FAIL was a nonessential mutable terminal title assertion; three exact text checks passed. Independent final actual terminal output/send-counter/held-release proof passed separately.

limitations: Already injected application input may render after ownership ACK; no generic application drain/rollback claim. Every future event/character checks lease generation, text paced4ms per character.
Physical Mac human/mobile input and native trackpad gestures untested.
No model API calls; independent image verification only.

independentQA.gatedStrictApplicationDrainDiagnostic: Observed one already-delivered text event1ms after ownership ACK; this is explicitly outside generic rollback guarantee. Timestamp resolution caveat.

nativeTerminalTakeover.detail: Exact unique lowercase printf output; controller frame counter stable after acknowledgment; real X11 held keys/buttons cleared. Wallpaper/panel personally inspected by independent QA.

appearanceRestoration.detail: QA restoration helper selected wrong panel task and timed out waiting for fixture marker; preserved separately from passed native terminal takeover.

nativeTiming.method: same viewer browser performance.now(): mousedown → first decoded standard fixture click-counter region change, polled by requestAnimationFrame
nativeTiming.detector: At least12 pixels differ by>45 in any RGB channel in the standard synchronous click-counter row. Supplemental marker update timers are excluded from latency.
nativeTiming.caveat: Sequential local synthetic headless browser run at1280x720/2CPUs/2GiB with builders idle; not physical human display latency or WAN benchmark.
